_source: SAP article.ws GET_DETAILS -> result.additionalMaterials (type Z, 'Zubehör'), read from a guest browser session on profishop.sanitastroesch.ch. No login: a plain https.get returns NOSESSION, but the session cookie a normal page visit creates is enough. 110 Klappgriff/Stützklappgriff/Klappsitz bases queried, 0 errors.
_scope: Klappgriff + Stützklappgriff + Duschklappsitz only. Haltegriff, Winkelgriff and Eckhaltegriff ship WITH their mounting material (Reji, 2026-08-22) and SAP agrees — a Haltegriff Hewi 801 returns no additionalMaterials at all. Einhängesitz hangs on a Winkelgriff and needs none.
_why_filtered: SAP's Zubehör group is a mixed bag. Of 52 distinct articles it named, only 28 are fixings; 13 are Montageplatte/Grundplatte/Abdeckung (a DIFFERENT part, kept separately under `plates`) and 11 are unrelated accessories (Papierhalter, Rückenstütze, Armlehne, Abdeckplatte) that were dropped — offering a Papierhalter as a screw option would be nonsense. The split is an identity PREFIX on the leading noun (the GLOBAL RULE's permitted exception).
_brands: The pairing is per ARTICLE, so it is brand-correct by construction — a Hewi Klappgriff gets Hewi fixings (4711 179/180/187/189/190), a Nosag one gets Nosag (4721 187/188). Never build this by filtering a generic Befestigungsmaterial family on brand.
_variants: Keyed by 7-digit BASE: the fixing set follows the model, not the finish. Verified — 4711 171.100.000 and 4711 171.339.000 return identical lists.

_plateFixings: A plate is screwed to the wall, so IT carries the anchors when the grab bar names none. SAP says so per article — queried on each of the 13 plates, 4 return a list. This is what takes the six Nosag Verso Care Klappgriffe off the warning row: 4722 241 names 4721 795/796/798, all Nosag, all already injected. Read from additionalMaterials, NOT parsed out of the plate's 'siehe 4721 795 - 798' text.
